{'component_name': 'Tic Tac Toe Application', 'description': 'The Tic Tac Toe Application container is a monolithic, self-contained unit that encapsulates all core functionalities required for a complete tic tac toe game experience. It includes:

- A user interface (UI) for two players to interact with the game, view the board, and receive real-time feedback.
- Core game logic for enforcing rules, managing turns, detecting wins/draws, and handling invalid moves.
- State management to track the board and player actions.
- Accessibility and usability features to ensure the game is usable by all, including keyboard navigation and screen reader support.
- Automated unit, integration, and UI testing (using Cypress).
- Comprehensive documentation for both users and developers.
- Interfaces and workflows to support collaboration with AI agents for architecture, design, testing, and deployment automation.

All components reside within a unified codebase, ensuring simple deployment, maintainability, and extensibility. No external API is exposed; all user interactions occur directly through the UI. The only external dependency is the test automation framework (Cypress).', 'interfaces': [], 'framework': '', 'platform': ''}
